name: Jogo da Nota
summary: Jogo da Nota is an online social-deduction party game for 2 to 12 players. Each round, one player secretly receives a score from 1 to 10 while another invents a subjective scale question (defining what "1" and "10" mean). The scorekeeper answers with a concrete example matching their hidden number, and everyone else tries to guess the exact score. Play in your browser with friends.
